estimate_kind: subjective engineering-completion ranges for the new practical goal
percentage_definition: Rough judgment about implementation, targeted tests and integration against PRACTICAL-GOAL.md, not checklist fraction, reliability, elapsed/remaining time or a weighted whole-OS score.

milestones.title: Preservation and practical workflow
milestones.basis: Preservation and checkpoints remain strong; final supported-profile handoff still open.

milestones.title: Requests, responses and recovery
milestones.basis: Actual Running/shutdown/reboot request paths and source-bound fork receipt tests advanced; native cancellation and final publication remain open.

milestones.title: Execution and comparison runner
milestones.basis: Sixteen actual diagnostic/application behaviors and reviewed runner/owner call-site adapters; final supported-suite timeout/negative closure remains.

milestones.title: Memory and mapping correctness
milestones.basis: Actual forbidden-write fault/recovery now accepted; mapping concurrency and complete restoration still unproved.

milestones.title: Useful C and Rust applications
milestones.basis: One actual standalone libc utility copied 10,247 binary bytes across buffers, checked its checksum, closed/reopened/read back the file and unlinked its output, with independent byte-exact collection and complete guest/owner retirement. Rust std and earlier useful apps remain accepted; native fork/exec/wait and the full required application set remain open.

milestones.title: Native lifecycle and restoration
milestones.basis: Accepted actual second-generation boot ran the unchanged signal application after public stop/destroy/release, with verified teardown. Complete mapping/callback/reference restoration and final-profile repeatability remain open; this adds no final quota credit.

milestones.title: Processes, threads and used syscalls
milestones.basis: Real contended pthread behavior and reviewed source fork transport/destructor joins advanced; native fork/exec/wait and final host authority remain unavailable.

milestones.title: Used FPU/vector state
milestones.basis: Actual AVX/YMM0-15 plus selected x87/control/TOP/MXCSR preservation passed across exercised syscall, blocked futex and signal paths on one assigned McKernel CPU. Later XSAVE copy-extent repair is source-integrated only; full used-feature/IFUNC closure, new image and final regression remain open.

milestones.title: Native modules and interfaces
milestones.basis: Earlier matched module build/load and repaired SMP native lifecycle remain accepted. Three later fork candidate builds have failed; the newest requires an FFI-safe opaque-pointer correction.

milestones.title: Rust and assembly integration
milestones.basis: Existing Rust/assembly integration retained; no new broad language-retirement or whole-image migration completion is established.

milestones.title: Repeatable runnable build
milestones.basis: Second affected module build and frozen corrected FPU image configure/build/artifact verification succeeded; final coherent clean recipe replay remains.

milestones.title: Integrated functional regression
milestones.basis: Five additional distinct behaviors plus actual lifecycle and focused compiler/protocol negatives; coherent final integrated regression remains.

milestones.title: Bounded repeatability and stress
milestones.basis: First public native cycle accepted. Final-profile two boots, ten cycles, 100 launches and 60-minute mixed workload remain incomplete.

milestones.title: Practical delivery
milestones.basis: More tested artifacts and exact recovery/run prerequisites retained; final runnable package, supported capability statement and final review remain open.

factual_progress_since_baseline.new_build_status: Third actual early-fork module build failed on three improper_ctypes FFI declarations; positive retirement independently accepted, narrow opaque-pointer correction in progress
factual_progress_since_baseline.supported_goal: Practical kernel and application infrastructure under the existing Linux control plane; comprehensive qualification deferred

comparison_policy: Preserve the original baseline and each comparison; future same-scope comparisons may report estimated range-midpoint percentage-point deltas with actual code/test/integration evidence.
Do not infer numerical gains from activity/tokens/time/commits or merely removing qualification requirements.
Do not sum or average overlapping milestone percentages into an OS score.
Keep unchanged/negative estimates when warranted; uncertainty or unassessed coverage is not zero engineering progress.
Do not change practical check status or original formal acceptance from these estimates.
